text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult woman with long black loose waves and braids drawn back at both temples, violet eyes, pale neutral skin, softly tapered oval face and natural rose lips. Gray lace high collar and layered gray draped gown, floral shoulder ornaments and a silver cross necklace. Level chin, camera exactly at eye height, neither chin tucked nor camera looking down. Continue the gray draped gown into a continuous ankle-length flowing layered skirt, opaque gray underdress beneath sheer lace details, dark gray elegant flats. Tall 178 cm healthy slender build. Exactly three equally spaced full-body views of ONE SAME person in one horizontal row: strict FRONT at left, strict 90-degree SIDE profile facing image-left in center, strict 180-degree BACK at right. Consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, shoes and 7.8-head tall long-limbed anatomy. Relaxed straight upright stance arms by sides. Every figure fully visible from hair to soles with margin, identical height, same baseline. Pure white ground, narrow white gutters, landscape 3:2. No text.
